response.explanation: Lines 12-21 of src/presentation/server.ts import eight persistence classes directly from src/persistence/repositories.ts: ApiaryRepository, HiveRepository, HarvestRepository, InspectionRepository, ProductRepository, ScaleRepository, TreatmentRepository and WeightReadingRepository. Line 22 also imports TextHiveClient from the persistence layer. The file already depends on the business layer: HiveService, ScaleService, TreatmentService, ReportService and the business error types (lines 2-11). createServer also takes those services as parameters (lines 56-60). So the HTTP layer reaches past the business layer and depends on concrete storage types. FF-S03 flags exactly this pattern, where presentation imports persistence without going through business. The excerpt ends at line 60, so it does not show whether the repositories are only used to wire things up (a composition-root pattern) or are called inside request handlers. Either way the source dependency crosses the layer boundary. Nothing in the material provided, whether docs, ADRs or comments, says what the intended layering is or allows this shortcut.
